gates.design: Tiered full-population multiple-case design (USER DECISION D1, 26 Sept 2026)
gates.note: Implements USER DECISIONS D1–D13 of 26 Sept 2026. Rename protocol_version to 'v3' (no DRAFT) only when §3.1 wording matches and the author freezes. No target counts exist anywhere in this file.

criteria.label: Distinct empirical source
criteria.definition: Not a duplicate, staging copy or administrative container of another entry.

criteria.label: Organisational episode
criteria.definition: Concerns an organisation of any size, not private/personal use (D2: no size restriction; size recorded in org_size).

criteria.label: Inside archive window
criteria.definition: Dated within the frozen archive window 2024-01-01 to 2026-08-24.

criteria.label: Lawful research access
criteria.definition: Source's controller assessment signed and no cross-border restriction pending. Pending (e.g. KVKK) = Unknown: held, not excluded, not read for research.

criteria.label: Material equipment-capital episode (functional + external floor)
criteria.definition: Both conditions: (1) FUNCTIONAL — the equipment, system or component is required for the buyer to deliver its core service, i.e. its absence stops or materially reduces service capacity, as documented in a contemporaneous source; (2) FLOOR — the total value of the commitment in the episode is at least HUF 200,000, the Hungarian small-value tangible asset limit (accounting and corporate tax), converted at the ECB reference rate on the invoice/proforma date (USER DECISIONS D14, 26 Sept 2026). Replacement parts and consumables (cables, electrodes, training suits) qualify when both conditions hold (D15); record the type in S1_equipment_type.

criteria.label: Equipment type (flag)
criteria.definition: Reporting flag (D15).

criteria.label: Reconstructable chronology
criteria.definition: At least two dated contemporaneous sources allow the sequence of events to be ordered.

criteria.label: Financing/payment architecture OR dated comparator role
criteria.definition: A financing or payment arrangement is documented, or a comparator role is recorded in a dated document that predates the outcome review.

criteria.label: Organisation size (flag)
criteria.definition: EU Recommendation 2003/361; how verified must be recorded in the reason column. Reporting flag only (D2).

criteria.label: ≥2 linked process steps evidenced
criteria.definition: At least two consecutive steps of the financing–payment–fulfilment–operational sequence are each supported by a dated source (D11).

criteria.label: Decision/outcome state mature for the mechanism claim
criteria.definition: The state needed for the mechanism claim (e.g. route chosen, route stalled, payment executed) is documented, not inferred.

criteria.label: Corroboration appropriate to the claim
criteria.definition: The central mechanism step is supported by a transactional/external record or by a source not authored by the researcher's firm.

criteria.label: Rival mechanisms considered (flag)
criteria.definition: Rival explanations listed for the mechanism (analysis step, D5).

criteria.label: Financing route evaluated
criteria.definition: Episode-level evidence that at least one financing route was evaluated.

criteria.label: Ex-ante expected durations documented
criteria.definition: Expected durations of the downstream stages are contemporaneous or structurally fixed; realised durations are descriptive only (D12).

criteria.label: Window Tier A/B
criteria.definition: Tier A (contractual/external) or B (documented operational) window; Tier C is Level 2 only.

criteria.label: Window established independently of outcome
criteria.definition: tW is documented in a source dated before the outcome, or set by a third party.

criteria.label: Required event R explicit
criteria.definition: The event that had to occur by tW is stated in the source.

criteria.label: Customer-side clocks independently sourced
criteria.definition: No customer-side clock (financing usability, payment) is dated solely by a source authored by the researcher's firm (D6).

criteria.label: Outcome mature (censoring flag)
criteria.definition: Flag; immature outcomes stay at Level 3 and are reported as censored (D5).

criteria.label: Clocks separable (classification input)
criteria.definition: If not separable the classification result is 'mixed/joint' (D5, D8).

criteria.label: Rivals coded incl. supplier delay (analysis step)
criteria.definition: Required analysis step for every Level 3 case, incl. 'supplier delay' (D5, D6).

criteria.label: Who set the window (flag)
criteria.definition: Seller-set windows form a sensitivity stratum.

extra_columns.hint: total commitment in the episode, converted at ECB rate on invoice date
pseudonymised source ID showing the equipment was needed for service
pseudonymous controller codes; key kept privately

multi-valued, separate with ';': Internal funds; Owner/family; Customer prepayment; Supplier credit; Captive/manufacturer finance; Third-party investor; Bank loan; Leasing; Grant/subsidy (KOSGEB, EU); Factoring; Card/short bridge; Unknown
e.g. bank transfer, card, cheque, letter of credit, lease contract, trade-in

criteria.label: Window documented before outcome
criteria.definition: The window endpoint tW is documented in a source dated before the outcome.

criteria.label: Required event R by tW
criteria.definition: The event R that had to occur by tW is explicit.

criteria.label: Mature outcome
criteria.definition: Outcome complete or mature enough to classify without speculation.

criteria.label: Triangulation
criteria.definition: ≥2 source types, or 1 strong external source plus independent corroboration.

criteria.label: Separable clocks
criteria.definition: Finance, payment, fulfilment, logistics and operational clocks can be dated separately.

criteria.label: Rival explanations coded
criteria.definition: Rival explanations explicitly coded for the episode.

stages.name: Episode analysis-readiness after source screening

criteria.label: Source→episode extraction complete (prerequisite)
criteria.definition: COMPLETE when the one-pass source→episode extraction in 03A is finished for this episode; otherwise PENDING (held, never excluded).

criteria.label: Original documents checked (prerequisite)
criteria.definition: Yes when the authorised primary screener (the author) has checked the original documents; otherwise PENDING (held, never excluded). 'No' is not a valid entry. The later blind independent-coder check is recorded separately.

criteria.label: Lawful research access
criteria.definition: Source's controller assessment signed and no cross-border restriction pending. Pending (e.g. KVKK) = Unknown: held, not excluded, not read for research.

criteria.label: Organisational episode
criteria.definition: Concerns an organisation of any size, not private/personal use (D2: no size restriction; size recorded in org_size).

criteria.label: Inside archive window
criteria.definition: Dated within the frozen archive window 2024-01-01 to 2026-08-24.

stages.note: Evaluated row by row. In sheet 05A each row is one episode, so this row-level stage is episode-level in practice; source-entry screening itself is recorded in 02A (Stage-0 audit) and 03A (source→episode extraction). ClockBind's 'entry' unit is kept so that failures read 'Outside analytic archive' and holds read 'Held at S0'.

criteria.label: Functional necessity (D14)
criteria.definition: The equipment, system or component was required for the buyer to deliver its service, shown by a contemporaneous document.

criteria.label: Commitment at or above the study's operational floor (HUF 200,000 equivalent)
criteria.definition: Materiality floor. An episode satisfies the monetary component of materiality when the contemporaneously documented total commitment is at least HUF 200,000, or its foreign-currency equivalent. HUF 200,000 is a study-specific ex-ante operational materiality floor, not a statutory, accounting, or universal definition of materiality. Functional necessity is assessed separately, and both conditions must be satisfied.

criteria.column: L1 ECB conversion (commitment-document date) verified or N/A?
criteria.label: Currency conversion verified (D14)
criteria.definition: For non-HUF transactions, conversion uses the ECB reference rate for the date of the contemporaneous transaction document used to establish the commitment amount; if no rate is published that day, the most recent preceding published working-day rate is used. N/A if the commitment is in HUF.

criteria.label: Reconstructable chronology
criteria.definition: At least two dated contemporaneous sources allow the sequence of events to be ordered.

criteria.column: L1 finance/payment arrangement OR pre-outcome comparator?
criteria.label: Financing/payment architecture OR dated comparator role
criteria.definition: A financing or payment arrangement is documented, or a comparator role is recorded in a dated document that predates the outcome review.

criteria.label: Organisation size (reporting flag, D2)
criteria.definition: EU Recommendation 2003/361 category; record how it was verified. Never a gate.

criteria.label: Equipment type (flag, D15)
criteria.definition: Replacement parts and consumables qualify when both D14 conditions hold.

criteria.label: ≥2 linked process steps evidenced
criteria.definition: At least two dependency-linked process steps in the episode-specific process network are each supported by a dated source; steps may be sequential, parallel or overlapping.

criteria.label: Decision/outcome state documented
criteria.definition: The state needed for the mechanism claim (e.g. route chosen, route stalled, payment executed) is documented, not inferred.

criteria.label: Corroboration appropriate to the claim
criteria.definition: The central mechanism step is supported by a transactional/external record or by a source not authored by the researcher's firm.

criteria.label: Rival mechanisms listed (analysis step)
criteria.definition: Rival explanations listed for the mechanism (analysis step, D5).

criteria.label: Financing route evaluated
criteria.definition: Episode-level evidence that at least one financing route was evaluated.

criteria.label: Ex-ante expected durations documented
criteria.definition: Expected durations of the downstream stages are contemporaneous or structurally fixed; realised durations are descriptive only (D12).

criteria.column: L3 Tier A/B window independent of outcome?
criteria.label: Tier A/B window set independently of the outcome
criteria.definition: Tier A (contractual/external) or B (documented operational) window, documented in a source dated before the outcome or set by a third party. Tier C windows are Level 2 only.

criteria.label: Required event R explicit
criteria.definition: The event that had to occur by tW is stated in the source.

criteria.column: L3 customer-side date has outside source?
criteria.label: Customer-side clocks independently sourced
criteria.definition: No customer-side clock (financing usability, payment) is dated solely by a source authored by the researcher's firm (D6).

criteria.label: Supplier-delay rival tested (analysis step, D6)
criteria.definition: Required analysis step for every Level 3 episode; not an admission gate.

criteria.label: Window setter recorded (flag)
criteria.definition: Buyer, seller or third party; seller-set windows form a sensitivity group.

criteria.label: Dependency network reconstructed (analysis step)
criteria.definition: The order of clocks is taken from contract and payment terms; parallel steps allowed.

criteria.column: L3 finance actionability assessed separately from binding?
criteria.label: Actionability reported separately from binding (analysis step)
criteria.definition: Finance actionability (slack ≥ 0) and finance-binding (counterfactual) are reported separately.

criteria.label: Reactive-downstream sensitivity (analysis step)
criteria.definition: Sensitivity check that relaxes the 'other clocks unchanged' assumption.

binding_rule.status: USER DECISION 27 Sept 2026; applied after the protocol freeze to Level 3 episodes only
binding_rule.definition: A clock binds if the required event R would have occurred by tW had that clock met its ex-ante expected duration, other clocks as documented. Only ex-ante expected durations are used; finance actionability (slack >= 0) is reported separately from binding.
binding_rule.jointly_binding: No single correction is sufficient; the specified combined correction is sufficient for R to occur by tW.
binding_rule.sign_stability: Slack is computed at the earliest and at the latest admissible date bounds; if the sign of the decisive slack differs, the verdict is Indeterminate.

claim_ceiling.A: Level 3; Tier A window; customer-side date independently sourced; sign-stable verdict; supplier-delay rival rejected; window not seller-set → 'shows' / 'was binding'
claim_ceiling.B: Level 3 otherwise → 'appears to be binding' / 'is consistent with'
claim_ceiling.none: Indeterminate, held or below Level 1 → 'cannot be determined'
claim_ceiling.overrides: Only with reason and date; counted and reported
